e.title: 高峰进修学院考试中心（IIQE / MPFE 官方考点）
e.title_en: PEAK Examination Centre (official IIQE / MPFE examination body)
e.title_hk: 高峰進修學院考試中心（IIQE / MPFE 官方考點）
e.summary: 香港法定专业资格考试官方举办机构：保险中介人资格考试（IIQE）与强积金考试（MPFE）报名与手册
e.summary_en: The official Hong Kong body administering statutory professional examinations, including IIQE and the MPF Schemes Examination
e.summary_hk: 香港法定專業資格考試官方舉辦機構：保險中介人資格考試（IIQE）與強積金考試（MPFE）報名與手冊
e.body: 高峰进修学院考试中心（PEAK Examination Centre，职业训练局 VTC 旗下，`peak.edu.hk/exam/`）是**香港多个法定与专业资格考试的官方举办机构**，其考试清单本身就是一张「香港持牌职业资格地图」：**保险中介人资格考试（IIQE）**、**强制性公积金计划考试（MPFE）**、地产代理/营业员资格考试、二级游乐船只操作人合格证明书考试、**ESG 认证专业人员考试**、专利代理人资格考试、升降机及自动梯工程师注册考试、杠杆式外汇交易考试、保安人员技能测试等；考点位于湾仔活道 27 号 VTC 大楼 1 楼，站内提供考试选择、在线报名流程（econline）、考试手册与 FAQ。对 RIAA：这是**本 wiki 既有 IIQE 与 MPFE 词条的官方源头**——[[iiqe-1]]（保险原理及实务）、[[iiqe-2]]（一般保险）、[[iiqe-3]]（长期保险）、[[iiqe-5]]（投资相连长期保险）与 [[mpfe]]（强积金考试）此前都只有知识内容而没有权威出处，本词条把它们锚定到官方考务入口；在香港，IIQE 是**从事保险中介工作的法定前置**，与精算资格（[[ashk-examination]]、[[iaa]] 体系）分属「执业主线」与「专业深化主线」两条路径，同属 [[industry-cpd]] 所描述的行业能力建设范畴；备考侧可与 [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]]（偿二代题库）、[[cii-ds-ai-qualification]] 搭配；适合作入行准备、执业资格与考试规划方向。
e.body_en: The PEAK Examination Centre (under the Vocational Training Council, `peak.edu.hk/exam/`) is **the official administering body for several statutory and professional examinations in Hong Kong**, and its examination list is itself a map of licensed professions in the city: the **Insurance Intermediaries Qualifying Examination (IIQE)**, the **Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Examination (MPFE)**, estate agent/salesperson qualifying examinations, the Pleasure Vessel Operator Grade 2 certificate examination, the **ESG Certified Professional Examination**, the patent attorney qualification examination, lift and escalator engineer registration examinations, leveraged foreign exchange trading examinations and security-guard trade tests. The centre is at 1/F, VTC Tower, 27 Wood Road, Wan Chai, and the site offers exam selection, an online enrolment flow (econline), handbooks and FAQs. For RIAA: this is **the official source behind this wiki’s existing IIQE and MPFE entries** — [[iiqe-1]] (principles and practice of insurance), [[iiqe-2]] (general insurance), [[iiqe-3]] (long term insurance), [[iiqe-5]] (investment-linked long term insurance) and [[mpfe]] previously carried only content and no authoritative origin, and this entry anchors them to the official examination portal; in Hong Kong the IIQE is a **statutory prerequisite for insurance intermediary work**, sitting on the "practising licence" line as distinct from the "professional deepening" line of actuarial qualifications ([[ashk-examination]], the [[iaa]] system), both falling under the industry capability building described by [[industry-cpd]]; for exam preparation it pairs with [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]] (the C-ROSS question bank) and [[cii-ds-ai-qualification]]; suits entry preparation, practising qualifications and exam planning.
e.body_hk: 高峰進修學院考試中心（PEAK Examination Centre，職業訓練局 VTC 旗下，`peak.edu.hk/exam/`）是**香港多個法定與專業資格考試的官方舉辦機構**，其考試清單本身就是一張「香港持牌職業資格地圖」：**保險中介人資格考試（IIQE）**、**強制性公積金計劃考試（MPFE）**、地產代理/營業員資格考試、二級遊樂船隻操作人合格證明書考試、**ESG 認證專業人員考試**、專利代理人資格考試、升降機及自動梯工程師註冊考試、槓桿式外匯交易考試、保安人員技能測試等；考點位於灣仔活道 27 號 VTC 大樓 1 樓。對 RIAA：這是**本 wiki 既有 IIQE 與 MPFE 詞條的官方源頭**——[[iiqe-1]]、[[iiqe-2]]、[[iiqe-3]]、[[iiqe-5]] 與 [[mpfe]] 此前都只有知識內容而沒有權威出處，本詞條把它們錨定到官方考務入口；在香港，IIQE 是**從事保險中介工作的法定前置**，與精算資格（[[ashk-examination]]、[[iaa]] 體系）分屬「執業主線」與「專業深化主線」兩條路徑；備考側可與 [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]]、[[cii-ds-ai-qualification]] 搭配；適合作入行準備、執業資格與考試規劃方向。
